popularity.method: Sum num_pushers across economies for the selected period, take the top 50 programming languages in Innovation Graph order, then normalize within those 50. Supplemental markup and mixed-language formats receive only the corpus coverage floor. Shiki IDs choose the labeling teacher and are never runtime model inputs.

data.policy: Preserve validation and test byte-for-byte; remove train rows overlapping held-out input.trim().toLowerCase(). No size-based sampling.

partialPolicy: Partial metrics count non-null candidates as accepted for compatibility with older reports. Candidates include uncertain ranges and are not accepted complete outputs.

examples.reason: There are no supervised positions to recognize.
